issue: REG-5876 mode minus denotes inhibition by NADH; MONOMER-12778 comment states stimulation by NADH and lesser NAD+. Both cite PMID8419288.
disposition: Native negative sign is rejected as accepted inhibition. PMID8419288 maintext and delayed-addition controls demonstrate NADH stimulation of aldolase in purified native CF600 DmpFG; lesser NAD+ stimulation is supported. Preserve original minus metadata as a source error/conflict, without inventing a direct nucleotide-binding or allosteric mechanism.

issue: Comment describes a heterodimer and crystallographic asymmetric unit of four heterodimers; component slots specify2 DmpG and2 DmpF.
disposition: Reconcile as biological tetramer of two DmpFG catalytic heterodimers (2 DmpG +2 DmpF). 1993 native solution estimate148kDa supports2+2; 2003 p6993 explicitly calls140kDa tetramer the active biological unit. The crystal asymmetric unit contains two tetramers/four heterodimers. A heterodimer is a subassembly, not the complete biological stoichiometry.

issue: Native regulation objects label Zn2+ inhibition and Mn2+ activation ALLOSTERIC.
disposition: Accept preparation-specific effects only from PMID8419288. The paper does not demonstrate those metal allosteric mechanisms; Mn2+ activation versus essential tightly bound metal remained unresolved. EDTA dialysis did not lower activity. Mg2+/Ca2+ had no effect in this CF600 preparation. Preserve native labels as uncorroborated context.
